text: 他爱你，他会不自觉的露出孩子那一面，年纪多大的男人都会对自己真心爱的人露出大男孩那一面，比如撒娇，扮可爱，用孩子的语气跟你说话。
en: He loves you, and he will unconsciously reveal his childlike side; no matter how old a man is, he will show his big-boy side to the person he truly loves — for instance, acting spoiled, being cute, and speaking to you in a child’s tone.

text: 很多（但不是全部）男生觉得女生等待爱情是一种SB行为，他们会觉得你很幼稚，但是不会明说。
en: Many (but not all) young men think a girl waiting for love is an idiotic behaviour; they will think you are naive, but will not say it outright.

text: 男人真的会对轻易得到的女人不会珍惜的。
en: Men really will not treasure a woman they get too easily.

text: 男人真的要娶你时候一切难关他都会一一去摆平排除。
en: When a man truly wants to marry you, he will settle and clear every difficulty one by one.

text: 对于娶老婆这事，男生是很理性的，虽然表面心里会爱你，但是如果你不适合他的结婚对象，他依然会理性的不会娶你。
en: When it comes to taking a wife, young men are very rational; although they may love you in their hearts on the surface, if you are not suited to be his marriage partner, he will still rationally choose not to marry you.

text: 谈不上男生，已经中年男人一枚了。
en: He is hardly a young man — he is already a middle-aged man.

text: 今年五月离了婚，此前前妻以过得不开心的理由离婚，跑回娘家不回来，我挽回了一年未果，最后只能离婚。
en: I divorced this May. Before that, my ex-wife filed for divorce on the grounds that she had been unhappy, ran back to her parents’ home and would not return. I tried to win her back for a year without success, and in the end could only divorce.

text: 离婚后，陆陆续续也谈了一些朋友，客观的说，有高学历的博士后，也有比我小十几岁的95后。
en: After the divorce, I dated a few people on and off. Objectively speaking, there were highly educated postdocs, and also post-95s more than ten years younger than me.

text: 自己单身一个人，工作上游刃有余领导重视，业余生活时而蓝天碧海，大好河山的旅游;时而秋天黄叶，咖啡独处的浪漫;时而海鲜美食，夜夜笙歌的狂欢。
en: On my own as a single person, I handle work with ease and my leaders value me. In my spare time, I sometimes travel to blue skies and seas and beautiful rivers and mountains; sometimes enjoy the romance of autumn yellow leaves and coffee alone; sometimes indulge in seafood feasts and nightly revelry.

text: 身边已婚的没事就表示对我的羡慕，有的羡慕我的自由;有的羡慕我可以在中年时重启人生和平时他们只能意淫的青春靓丽的女孩约会，上床;有的羡慕我可以再次有机会抛掉过去体重和我差不多一样重，只有中专学历且性格极端的前妻再开始人生。
en: Married people around me constantly express their envy of me — some envy my freedom; some envy that I can restart my life in middle age and date and sleep with the youthful, beautiful girls they can only lust after in their imagination; some envy that I have another chance to cast off my ex-wife, who weighed about the same as me, had only a secondary vocational education and an extreme temperament, and start life anew.

text: 还有的觉得看我现在精神状态潇洒自如，我什么负担没有，说上天对我很眷顾。
en: Others feel that, seeing how carefree and at ease my mental state is now, I have no burdens at all, and say heaven has been very kind to me.

text: 其实只有我自己知道，无数个夜里，我梦到前妻，梦到我们曾经朝夕相处的家难过的在梦里流泪;也只有我知道当我开车经过她上班的单位附近时，都会停车向那个方向望去。
en: In truth only I know that on countless nights I dream of my ex-wife, dream of the home we once shared day and night, and weep sorrowfully in my dreams; only I know that whenever I drive past near the unit where she works, I stop the car and gaze in that direction.

text: 我也从不在她家附近和她单位附近吃饭，因为担心自己会去想:她有没有吃饭，晚饭吃的好不好。
en: I also never eat near her home or near her workplace, because I worry I would start to wonder: has she eaten, did she have a good dinner.

text: 昨天还做了梦，梦见我带着个离婚后已经被她带走的当当(雪纳瑞狗名)，去看电影，看见了她，她穿的又破又旧，比以前更加胖了。
en: Just yesterday I had a dream in which I took Dangdang (a schnauzer’s name), who had already been taken away by her after the divorce, to see a film, and I saw her — dressed in ragged, worn clothes, fatter than before.

text: 我在梦里眼泪就流了出来，责备着自己没有照顾好她，现在让她过成这样，哭着哭着就醒了。
en: In the dream tears streamed down my face as I blamed myself for not taking good care of her, for letting her life come to this, and I woke up crying.

text: 没错，大家只看到了我的潇洒，并不知道我心里的难过。
en: That’s right — everyone only saw my carefree manner, and did not know the sadness in my heart.

text: 非常感谢大家的回复，真没有想到有这么多人关注，关心和评论。
en: Many thanks for everyone’s replies; I truly did not expect so many people to follow, care and comment.

text: 答主发这个帖子是早晨时，因为晚上梦到了前妻，心里很难过 就把这个事当做日记一样写了出来。
en: The poster wrote this post in the morning, because he had dreamed of his ex-wife at night and felt very sad, so he wrote it out like a diary entry.

text: 其实我有时就是把知乎当写日记的地方，很多话不想让身边同事朋友知道，但是又想写出来(我身边人大多不知知乎为何物)。
en: Actually, sometimes I just treat Zhihu as a place to keep a diary; there is much I do not want colleagues and friends around me to know, yet I want to write it out (most people around me do not know what Zhihu is).

text: 我发时候，以为多说能有两三个人评论，没想到这么多人关注，大吃一惊。
en: When I posted, I thought at most two or three people would comment, and was greatly surprised that so many people paid attention.

text: 看了大家的回复，收了这么多建议和祝福，心里还是很感激大家的关心或者同情(不知道这个词用的合适不合适)。
en: Having read everyone’s replies and received so many suggestions and blessings, I am still very grateful for everyone’s care or sympathy (I am not sure whether that word is appropriate).

text: 有这么多人关注，还有人有疑问，我就多写点，也便于大家少一些疑惑。
en: With so many people paying attention and some having questions, I will write a bit more, so as to save everyone some confusion.

text: 答主生活在东北的沈阳，一个地道的东北男人。
en: The poster lives in Shenyang in the Northeast, a true Northeastern man.

text: 从没在东北以外的地方工作生活过，未来有可能去南方，看那边挖我的薪酬，这是后话。
en: He has never worked or lived anywhere outside the Northeast; he may go south in future, depending on the salary they offer to poach him there — but that is another story.

text: 答主结婚五年，和她相处八年，这可能是一直一来这段感情让自己受了很大的伤恢复的很缓慢的原因。
en: The poster was married for five years and had been with her for eight; this may be why this relationship has wounded him so deeply and his recovery has been so slow all along.

text: 人生，有几个八年呢？
en: How many eight-year stretches does a life have?

text: 况且朝夕相处。
en: Moreover, they were together day and night.

text: 她在一个商场花店做店长，答主是一个国企的中层干部。
en: She was a shop manager at a flower shop in a shopping mall, and the poster was a mid-level cadre in a state-owned enterprise.

text: 她收入在五千左右，答主综合收入在大概是是她的接近三倍左右。
en: Her income was around five thousand, and the poster’s total income was roughly close to three times hers.

text: 我们的生活水平在这个城市属于小康水平，车房均有，房三套，两套是婚前财产，一套婚后财产(用我自己钱买的)，离婚后这套八十平的房子给了她。
en: Our standard of living counted as moderately comfortable in this city; we had both a car and flats — three flats in total, two being pre-marital property and one post-marital property (bought with my own money), and after the divorce this eighty-square-metre flat was given to her.

text: 车我自己留下了。
en: I kept the car myself.

text: 因为车是我母亲婚后第二年送给我的。
en: Because the car was a gift from my mother in the second year of our marriage.

text: 离婚时她提出想要房子，我就给她了。
en: When we divorced, she asked for the flat, so I gave it to her.

text: 她父母很感激我给她这套房子，但是我家亲戚和朋友都反对，但是我最后还是决定给她。
en: Her parents were very grateful that I gave her this flat, but my relatives and friends all objected; nevertheless I finally decided to give it to her.

text: 原因是她没有自己的房子，我把它作为给她最后的保障吧。
en: The reason was that she had no flat of her own, and I treated it as a final safeguard for her.

text: 离婚原因，既简单又复杂。
en: The reasons for the divorce were both simple and complex.

text: 表面看 仅仅是我俩看电影后因为一点小事拌了几句嘴，然后吵架，有两天赌气互相没说话。
en: On the surface, it was merely that after watching a film we exchanged a few bickering words over a trivial matter, then had a row, and for two days sulked and did not speak to each other.

text: 后来说话后，因为什么事又吵了起来，她当夜就要离家出走，我不让，。
en: Later, after we spoke again, we quarrelled once more over something, and that very night she wanted to run away from home; I would not let her.

text: 第二天我以为没事了，去她单位接她，她说她已经回娘家了，开始时说回去住几天，但是后来就不回来了，过了两个礼拜她说过不下去了，离婚吧，好聚好散。
en: The next day I thought it was fine and went to her workplace to pick her up; she said she had already gone back to her parents’ home. At first she said she would stay a few days, but then she would not come back. After two weeks she said she could not go on, let’s divorce, and part on good terms.

text: 她回娘家后才不到二十天，在微信里删除了所有我和她的回忆，结婚，送她的无数礼物，一起旅游，一起过生日的照片，QQ也无法再访问她的空间了。
en: Less than twenty days after she went back to her parents’ home, she deleted all the memories of her and me on WeChat — the wedding, the countless gifts I gave her, the photos of our travels and birthdays together — and I could no longer visit her QQ space either.

text: 我不同意离婚，就一直在挽回，这是2016年6月的事，期间我去他家找了她三十多次，去她单位找她谈了差不多二十次 找她父母谈了十几次，我妈找她谈了四五次。
en: I did not agree to the divorce and kept trying to win her back; this was in June 2016. During that time I went to her home to look for her more than thirty times, went to her workplace to talk with her nearly twenty times, talked with her parents a dozen or so times, and my mother spoke with her four or five times.

text: 找她闺蜜和她和我认识的朋友谈了许多次。
en: I talked with her close friend and the friends she and I both knew many times.

text: 挽回的信和留言写了几十封，其中长的有两万字那么长
en: I wrote dozens of letters and messages trying to win her back, the longest of which was as long as twenty thousand characters.

text: 但是，都没有效果，她坚持离婚。
en: But none of it worked; she insisted on the divorce.

text: 说过的不开心，我不够关心她，脾气还大，家务做的少，社交应酬多…
en: She said she had been unhappy, that I did not care enough for her, had a bad temper, did little housework, and had too many social engagements…

text: 她说没孩子，离婚了都可以各自重新选择自己的人生，她宁愿赌一把，万一赌赢了，是她的福分，赌输了，她认命。
en: She said there were no children, so after divorcing each could choose their own life anew; she would rather take a gamble — if she won, it was her good fortune; if she lost, she would accept her fate.

text: 就这样，后来就这样她拒绝回来，分居中。
en: And so, later on, she refused to come back and we lived apart.

text: 所以，我在2017年五月和她离婚时，已经实际分居一年了。
en: So when I divorced her in May 2017, we had already been separated in practice for a year.

text: 在这一年的挽回时间中，我也逐渐攒够了失望。
en: During this year of trying to win her back, I also gradually accumulated enough disappointment.

text: 从我过生日和我妈过生日聚在一起试图挽回，到她过生日和情人节买苹果手机和首饰，大衣，化妆品，再到亲自下厨学做孜然羊肉，土豆烧牛肉，牛肉炖萝卜给她送去单位。
en: From combining my birthday and my mother’s birthday gatherings to try to win her back, to buying her an iPhone, jewellery, a coat and cosmetics for her birthday and Valentine’s Day, to personally learning to cook cumin lamb, braised beef with potatoes, and beef stew with radish and taking them to her workplace.

text: 都试过了，她就是坚决离婚，当然东西都收了。
en: I tried it all, yet she was determined to divorce — though of course she accepted the things.

text: 所以，有人问我努力没有，我想说，尽力了，没有遗憾了。
en: So when someone asks whether I tried, I want to say: I did my best, and have no regrets.

text: 失望也是积攒的，尤其这一年中，有一次我开二十多公里车晚上给她送一盒抹茶蛋糕，在她家等了她三个多小时，她看到蛋糕第一句话披头盖脸的说:你想胖死我啊！
en: Disappointment also builds up. Especially in that year, once I drove more than twenty kilometres one evening to bring her a box of matcha cake, and waited at her home for over three hours; the first thing she said on seeing the cake was, bluntly: “Are you trying to fatten me to death!”

text: 你啥时同意办手续啊！
en: “When are you going to agree to the formalities!”

text: 听完 心里刀割一样难过。
en: Hearing that, my heart ached as if cut by a knife.

text: 她跑回家才四个月，我生日就不记得了。
en: She had been back at her parents’ home only four months, yet already forgot my birthday.

text: 同样，离婚后才四个月，我生日也忘记了。
en: Likewise, just four months after the divorce, she forgot my birthday too.

text: 春节时我还抱有希望希望她回来，可是她既没有来我家看看我妈，去初三去她家时，她也躲着我。
en: During the Spring Festival I still held out hope that she would return, yet she neither came to my home to see my mother; when I went to her home on the third day of the lunar new year, she also avoided me.

text: 但是还是不死心，我四月份胳膊做骨折康复取钢板手术，住了十几天院，她只来了两次，一次只坐了十几分钟。
en: But I still would not give up. In April I had an operation to remove a steel plate during fracture rehabilitation on my arm and was hospitalised for over ten days; she came only twice, and one visit lasted only a little over ten minutes.

text: 于是 攒够了失望。
en: Thus my disappointment was complete.

text: 同意了离婚。
en: I agreed to the divorce.

text: 离婚前，我俩原定的日子因为意外，没办上，我说:这是老天让我们再考虑一次啊!
en: Before the divorce, the date we had originally set fell through because of an accident; I said: “This is heaven giving us one more chance to think it over!”

text: 她说:今天不行就明天，明天不行就下周!
en: She said: “If today doesn’t work, then tomorrow; if tomorrow doesn’t work, then next week!”

text: 就这样，我也对她这样攒够了失望，办了手续。
en: And so, having also accumulated enough disappointment with her in this way, we went through the formalities.

text: 办手续久，她催促把房子手续办了，我当时说要不房子不分割，把它当做我们之间纽带，房证都放你那，租金你也都拿着，我单位还能报销九十平的采暖费…
en: After the formalities, she urged me to sort out the flat’s paperwork. I then said, why not leave the flat undivided and treat it as a bond between us — keep both property certificates with you, you keep the rent too, and my workplace can still reimburse the heating fee for ninety square metres…

text: 她不同意，要分的清楚。
en: She disagreed and wanted a clean division.

text: 所以按她要求办了。
en: So it was done as she requested.

text: 离婚当天和后来因为我还给她买白金项链和阿玛尼的包，被朋友说我贱。
en: On the day of the divorce and afterwards, because I also bought her a platinum necklace and an Armani bag, friends said I was pathetic.

text: 我自嘲:我有一颗红楼梦的心，活在水浒的世界里。
en: I mocked myself: I have a heart of Dream of the Red Chamber, yet live in the world of Water Margin.

text: 离婚后，从来嗤之以鼻的心灵鸡汤，也经常看。
en: After the divorce, I also frequently read the chicken soup for the soul that I had always turned my nose up at.

text: 离婚前挽回时看了武志红老师的《爱为何让人受伤》，我曾把书拿到她家，建议了四五次看看，最终她也没看。
en: While trying to win her back before the divorce, I read Teacher Zhihong Wu’s “Why Love Hurts”, and I took the book to her home and suggested four or five times that she read it, but in the end she never did.

text: 倒是喜欢转咪蒙的文章，类似于吵了架的婚姻就像砒霜什么的。
en: Instead, she liked to repost Meng Mi’s articles, the sort about how a marriage full of rows is like arsenic and so on.

text: 有人问你的思念，为什么不告诉她?告诉了，有的直接发给她，她要么不回应 要么说晚了。
en: Someone asked: why not tell her about your longing? I told her — some messages I sent directly to her, and she either did not respond or said it was too late.

text: 有的我发在只有她能看到的分组里，她因为不想看，把我朋友圈屏蔽了。
en: Some I posted in a group visible only to her, but because she did not want to see them, she blocked my moments.

text: 离婚后，处了一些女孩，有正式处对象的，也有两方面或者一方面对确立关系犹豫不决的。
en: After the divorce I dated some girls — some were proper relationships, and with others either both sides or one side hesitated to commit.

text: 进入九月份，开始身边有人积极介绍对象，找条件不好的，自己有点不甘心。
en: Entering September, people around me began actively introducing partners. If I looked for someone with poor prospects, I felt a bit unwilling.

text: 自己想找年轻漂亮条件好的，又担心hold不住，所以索性顺其自然。
en: I wanted to find someone young, beautiful and well-off, yet worried I could not hold on to her, so I simply let things take their natural course.

text: 自己想想，保持几年单身状态也不是活不了，自己确实应该培养下自己独处的能里了。
en: Thinking about it, staying single for a few years is not unliveable; I really should cultivate my ability to be alone.

text: 婚姻也不是弱者报团取暖，而是强者锦上添花。
en: Marriage is not the weak huddling together for warmth, but the strong adding flowers to brocade.

text: 失去了家庭的稳定和习惯，还可以收获自由和精彩。
en: Having lost the stability and habits of a family, one can still gain freedom and splendour.

text: 身边的人也分两派，一派站在家庭的角度，认为应该找老实本分，离异短婚的 条件差点也应该接纳，以“过日子”为大。
en: People around me also split into two camps. One camp, standing from the family’s perspective, holds that one should find someone honest and decent, divorced or briefly married, and accept them even with worse prospects, prioritising “getting by in life”.

text: 另一派表示，难得有重新选择的机会，坚决不能将就，要找年轻漂亮的，优秀的，一定要选为了爱情的。
en: The other camp says that a chance to choose anew is rare, and one must absolutely not settle — one should find someone young, beautiful and excellent, and must choose for the sake of love.

text: 要让别人认识到你的魅力。
en: Let others recognise your charm.

text: 所以，自己也有点迷惑，最后还是遵循自己的内心吧，一定能等到属于自己那个，失去的是过往 留下的是人生。
en: So I am a little confused too, but in the end I will follow my own heart; I will surely wait for the one who belongs to me — what is lost is the past, what remains is life.

text: 关于上床，自己真的没有夜夜笙歌放弃自己，借酒浇愁，一来答主属于不吸烟不怎么喝酒的，答主更愿意踢踢球，唱唱歌，喝点咖啡刷刷知乎，或者出去旅旅游散散心。
en: Regarding sleeping together, I truly have not abandoned myself to nightly revelry and drowned my sorrows in drink; for one thing, the poster does not smoke and rarely drinks, and prefers kicking a football, singing, having some coffee and browsing Zhihu, or going travelling to relax.

text: 但是正常交往，男欢女爱 楼主也不是十八岁了，你情我愿实属正常。
en: But in normal socialising, mutual affection between men and women — the poster is no longer eighteen, and consensual intimacy is perfectly normal.

text: 没有打着处对象骗炮的事，也没有第一次见面就上床的事，都是交往了好一段顺其自然。
en: There was no pretending to be in a relationship to trick anyone into bed, nor sleeping together on the first meeting; it all came naturally after a good while of dating.

text: 她们对我的情况也是完全知晓的，可能只是有的对于我，她们更愿意谈恋爱，但是对于结婚 久犹豫不决。
en: They were also fully aware of my situation; it may simply be that some, towards me, preferred to date, yet hesitated for a long time over marriage.

text: 我也没有勉强，就按着他们的意愿赖吧，毕竟你总会等到属于你的那个人。
en: I did not force it either; I just let things be according to their wishes, for after all you will always wait for the one who belongs to you.

text: 关于未来，一切都有命中注定，不用勉强。
en: Regarding the future, everything is predestined, and there is no need to force it.

text: 有句话说的，不属于你的，无论怎么努力都会失去，属于你的 即使远隔千里，最终会到你身边。
en: As a saying goes, what does not belong to you will be lost no matter how hard you try; what belongs to you, even if a thousand miles away, will in the end come to your side.

text: 最后 上两张照片吧，当年结婚时的风华正茂还有过生日时送她的当当的照片。
en: Finally, let me post two photos — one of my youthful vigour at our wedding, and one of Dangdang, whom I gave her on her birthday.

text: 为了保护隐私，她的面部我就遮挡了，毕竟希望她以后也能找到自己的幸福。
en: To protect privacy, I have obscured her face, for I hope after all that she too will find her own happiness in future.
